name: Trap Bar Deadlift
steps: Stand in the center of the trap bar with feet hip-width apart.
Bend your hips and knees to grasp the middle of each handle with your arms straight.
Set your lats down, lift your chest slightly, and brace your core tightly to take slack out of the handles.
Drive forcefully through your midfoot and heels to extend your hips and knees together until you stand tall with shoulders aligned over your hips.
Hinge back at your hips and bend your knees smoothly to lower the trap bar back to the floor under control.
tips: Grip the exact center of both handles so the trap bar rises evenly without tilting forward or backward.
Avoid leaning backward at the top; finish tall by squeezing your glutes firmly.
